name: omarchy-theme-manager
description: Quality tooling for the Omarchy Theme Manager plugin.

scripts.lint:qml: /usr/lib/qt6/bin/qmllint -i /usr/share/omarchy/shell/Commons/qmldir -i /usr/share/omarchy/shell/Ui/qmldir v0200/ImagePicker.qml v0200/ThemeManagerController.qml v0200/ThemeCatalogController.qml v0200/WallpaperBrowserController.qml v0200/WallhavenFilterBar.qml v0200/WallhavenFilterSheet.qml v0200/ImagePickerModel.js v0200/ThemeManagerModel.js v0200/ThemeCatalogModel.js v0200/WallpaperBrowserModel.js
scripts.lint:shell: shellcheck list.sh catalog.sh theme-inventory.sh tests/lab/acceptance.sh && shfmt -d -i 2 -ci -bn list.sh catalog.sh theme-inventory.sh tests/lab/acceptance.sh
scripts.format: prettier --write 'v*/**/*.js' 'tests/*.js' '*.mjs' '*.json' '*.md' 'assets/*.md' && shfmt -w -i 2 -ci -bn list.sh catalog.sh theme-inventory.sh tests/lab/acceptance.sh
scripts.quality: npm run test && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:qml && npm run format:check && npm run validate
